## 📝 Generated Test Skeletons

### Backend Integration Tests (`backend/tests/integration/test_patient_search_api.py`)

```python
"""
Integration tests for Patient Search API (Sprint 1 PRD compliance).

Tests all functional requirements (FR1-FR8) end-to-end through API endpoints.
"""
import pytest
from uuid import uuid4
from datetime import date

from app.schemas.patient_search import PatientSearchRequest, SearchFilters, Pagination


@pytest.mark.asyncio
class TestPatientSearchAPI:
    """
    PRD Requirement: FR1 - Search by Medical Concept
    PRD Requirement: FR2 - Meta-Annotation Filtering
    PRD Requirement: FR3 - Result Ranking & Pagination
    """

    async def test_search_by_concept_name(self, client, test_db, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR1.1: Search by concept name returns matching patients

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - POST /api/v1/patients/search with concept="diabetes" returns 200 OK
        - Response includes results array
        - Response includes pagination object
        - Response includes performance object
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {"temporal": "current", "includeNegated": False, "includeFamily": False},
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()

        # FR1: Response structure
        assert "results" in data
        assert "pagination" in data
        assert "performance" in data

        # FR3: Pagination structure (PRD-compliant nested object)
        assert "page" in data["pagination"]
        assert "pageSize" in data["pagination"]
        assert "totalResults" in data["pagination"]
        assert "totalPages" in data["pagination"]
        assert data["pagination"]["page"] == 1
        assert data["pagination"]["pageSize"] == 20

        # FR1: Performance tracking
        assert "searchTime" in data["performance"]
        assert "source" in data["performance"]
        assert data["performance"]["searchTime"] > 0


    async def test_search_by_cui(self, client, test_db, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR1.2: Search by SNOMED-CT CUI returns matching patients

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - POST /api/v1/patients/search with concept="C0011849" (diabetes CUI) returns 200 OK
        - Results include patients with diabetes mentions
        - CUI format: C followed by digits
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "C0011849",  # Diabetes mellitus CUI
            "filters": {"temporal": "current", "includeNegated": False, "includeFamily": False},
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()
        assert "results" in data

        # FR1.2: CUI search works (may return 0 results if no test data)
        assert isinstance(data["results"], list)


    async def test_search_empty_query_returns_400(self, client, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR1.3: Empty query returns validation error

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - POST /api/v1/patients/search with concept="" returns 400 Bad Request
        - Error message indicates validation failure
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "",  # Empty query
            "filters": {},
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert
        assert response.status_code == 422  # Pydantic validation error
        # Note: 422 is FastAPI's default for Pydantic validation, not 400


    async def test_negation_filter_excludes_negated(self, client, test_db_with_annotations, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR2.1: Negation filter excludes negated mentions

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - Search with includeNegated=false excludes "no diabetes" mentions
        - Only "Affirmed" Negation meta-annotations returned
        - Precision improves from 60% to 90%+

        Test Data Requirements:
        - Patient A: "has diabetes" (Negation=Affirmed)
        - Patient B: "no diabetes" (Negation=Negated)

        Expected Result: Only Patient A returned
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {
                "temporal": "any",
                "includeNegated": False,  # Exclude negated
                "includeFamily": True
            },
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()

        # FR2.1: All annotations have Negation=Affirmed
        for result in data["results"]:
            for annotation in result["annotations"]:
                assert annotation["metaAnnotations"]["negated"] is False


    async def test_temporal_filter_current_only(self, client, test_db_with_annotations, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR2.2: Temporality filter excludes historical mentions

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - Search with temporal="current" excludes "patient had diabetes 10 years ago"
        - Only "Current" or "Recent" Temporality meta-annotations returned

        Test Data Requirements:
        - Patient A: "has diabetes" (Temporality=Current)
        - Patient B: "had diabetes 10 years ago" (Temporality=Historical)

        Expected Result: Only Patient A returned
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {
                "temporal": "current",  # Current only
                "includeNegated": True,
                "includeFamily": True
            },
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()

        # FR2.2: All annotations have Temporality in [Current, Recent]
        for result in data["results"]:
            for annotation in result["annotations"]:
                assert annotation["metaAnnotations"]["temporality"] in ["Current", "Recent"]


    async def test_experiencer_filter_patient_only(self, client, test_db_with_annotations, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR2.3: Experiencer filter excludes family history

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - Search with includeFamily=false excludes "father has diabetes"
        - Only "Patient" Experiencer meta-annotations returned

        Test Data Requirements:
        - Patient A: "has diabetes" (Experiencer=Patient)
        - Patient B's document: "father has diabetes" (Experiencer=Family)

        Expected Result: Only Patient A returned (Patient B excluded despite mention in their document)
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {
                "temporal": "any",
                "includeNegated": True,
                "includeFamily": False  # Exclude family
            },
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()

        # FR2.3: All annotations have Experiencer=Patient
        for result in data["results"]:
            for annotation in result["annotations"]:
                assert annotation["metaAnnotations"]["experiencer"] == "Patient"


    async def test_multiple_filters_and_logic(self, client, test_db_with_annotations, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR2.4: Multiple filters applied as AND conditions

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - All filters must match (AND logic, not OR)
        - temporal="current" AND includeNegated=false AND includeFamily=false
        - Only annotations matching ALL conditions returned
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {
                "temporal": "current",
                "includeNegated": False,
                "includeFamily": False
            },
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act
        response = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert
        assert response.status_code == 200
        data = response.json()

        # FR2.4: All annotations match ALL filters
        for result in data["results"]:
            for annotation in result["annotations"]:
                assert annotation["metaAnnotations"]["temporality"] in ["Current", "Recent"]
                assert annotation["metaAnnotations"]["negated"] is False
                assert annotation["metaAnnotations"]["experiencer"] == "Patient"


    async def test_search_pagination(self, client, test_db_100_patients, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        FR3.3: Pagination (page, pageSize, totalResults, totalPages)

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - Request page=1, pageSize=20 returns first 20 results
        - Request page=2, pageSize=20 returns next 20 results (different patients)
        - pagination.totalResults accurate across all pages
        - pagination.totalPages calculated correctly (ceiling division)

        Test Data: 100 patients with diabetes (requires test fixture)
        Expected: 5 total pages (100 / 20 = 5)
        """
        # Arrange
        request_page_1 = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {},
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        request_page_2 = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {},
            "pagination": {"page": 2, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        # Act - Page 1
        response_1 = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request_page_1,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Act - Page 2
        response_2 = await client.post(
            "/api/v1/patients/search",
            json=request_page_2,
            headers=auth_headers_clinician
        )

        # Assert - Page 1
        assert response_1.status_code == 200
        data_1 = response_1.json()
        assert data_1["pagination"]["page"] == 1
        assert data_1["pagination"]["pageSize"] == 20
        assert len(data_1["results"]) <= 20

        # Assert - Page 2
        assert response_2.status_code == 200
        data_2 = response_2.json()
        assert data_2["pagination"]["page"] == 2
        assert data_2["pagination"]["pageSize"] == 20

        # FR3.3: Different results on different pages
        if len(data_1["results"]) > 0 and len(data_2["results"]) > 0:
            page_1_mrns = {r["mrn"] for r in data_1["results"]}
            page_2_mrns = {r["mrn"] for r in data_2["results"]}
            assert page_1_mrns != page_2_mrns  # Different patients

        # FR3.3: totalResults and totalPages consistent
        assert data_1["pagination"]["totalResults"] == data_2["pagination"]["totalResults"]
        assert data_1["pagination"]["totalPages"] == data_2["pagination"]["totalPages"]
```

### Backend Performance Tests (`backend/tests/performance/test_search_performance.py`)

```python
"""
Performance tests for Patient Search API (NFR1 - Performance).

Tests response time targets for clinical workflow integration.
"""
import pytest
import time
import asyncio


@pytest.mark.performance
@pytest.mark.asyncio
class TestPatientSearchPerformance:
    """
    PRD Requirement: NFR1 - Performance
    Target: <500ms for 10,000 patients (P95)
    """

    async def test_search_performance_10k_patients(self, client, test_db_10k_patients, auth_headers_clinician):
        """
        NFR1.1: Search response time <500ms for 10,000 patients (P95)

        Acceptance Criteria:
        - Search completes in <500ms (95th percentile)
        - Acceptable for clinical workflow (doesn't interrupt care)
        - Database indexes optimize query

        Test Data: Requires fixture with 10,000 patients + annotations
        Test Method: Run 100 searches, calculate P95
        """
        # Arrange
        request = {
            "concept": "diabetes",
            "filters": {
                "temporal": "current",
                "includeNegated": False,
                "includeFamily": False
            },
            "pagination": {"page": 1, "pageSize": 20},
            "sort": "relevance"
        }

        timings = []

        # Act - Run 100 searches to get P95
        for i in range(100):
            start = time.time()
            response = await client.post(
                "/api/v1/patients/search",
                json=request,
                headers=auth_headers_clinician
            )
            duration_ms = (time.time() - start) * 1000
            timings.append(duration_ms)

            assert response.status_code == 200

        # Assert - Calculate P95 (95th percentile)
        timings.sort()
        p95_index = int(len(timings) * 0.95)
        p95_time = timings[p95_index]

        # NFR1.1: P95 < 500ms
        assert p95_time < 500, f"P95 response time {p95_time}ms exceeds 500ms target"

        # Log performance metrics
        avg_time = sum(timings) / len(timings)
        print(f"\\nPerformance Results (10k patients):")
        print(f"  Average: {avg_time:.2f}ms")
        print(f"  P95: {p95_time:.2f}ms")
        print(f"  Max: {max(timings):.2f}ms")
```
